_comment: auto_from_game_items: every unlocked EquipmentAsset in auto_groups gets a recipe from the game's own item cost (cost_resource_id_1/2 and cost_gold). Results are rolled with the game's item generator (modifiers included). 'recipes' adds or replaces recipes by id; 'disabled' removes recipes by id (auto recipe ids are 'auto:<item id>'). near_buildings: building asset ids, or prefixes ending with '*', that must be within station_radius tiles.
